page.overview:
Who is Bertha?

Bertha is a member of the Sinnoh Elite Four. She specializes in -type Pokémon.

Bertha is an aging woman, whose appearance and name resembles Agatha: they both have the same hairstyle and the suffix "tha" in their English names. Bertha wears a brown scarf, a white buttoned coat, a black skirt, long grey socks and black shoes.

Despite her humble and gentle demeanor, Bertha holds herself as a strong and enduring trainer. She knows when she's beaten and doesn't regret defeat.

Her Japanese name, Kikuno, may be derived from 崎嶇 (kiku, steep) or 国 (kuni, country). In either event, it may also come from Kikuko, Agatha's Japanese name, as both are elderly women who are part of their region's Elite Four lineup.
